details.summary: Availability increased 1.7% this week vs last week. Despite this improvement, we have seen unexpected drops in BWS, Fresh and Bakery.
Waste score increased 2.3% this week vs last week, and 14% of this increase is due to improved sell through in Ready Meals.

successes.title: Improved Availability in BWS
successes.description: This week, we saw a 5% improvement in availability for the Beers, Wines & Spirits category, driven by better inventory management and staff training.
successes.impact: This improvement contributed to a 0.5% increase in overall availability score and helped us maintain our position as the top performer in the region.

successes.title: Reduced Waste in Ready Meals
successes.description: Through targeted interventions such as improved demand forecasting and promotional strategies, we achieved a 10% reduction in waste for the Ready Meals category.
successes.impact: This reduction in waste contributed to a 0.5% increase in our overall waste score and significantly improved our sell-through rate.

actions.ISSUE: MARKDOWN COMPLIANCE: Trending down this week, resulting in an increase in Straight to Bin
actions.EXPLANATION: 62% of markdowns occurred outside of the recommended window this week. Straight to Bin waste has increased by 70% as a result. This is compared to 96% compliance in the previous week, where the Straight to Bin was much lower,
actions.COST_IF_NOT_FIXED: If this continues, the store could lose approximately £2,500 in the next month.
actions.RECOMMENDED_ACTION: Review availability in IN-STORE BAKERY daily, especially on Fridays. Ensure replenishment orders are raised before 8am and all gaps on high-velocity lines are filled before the store opens.Coach the teams and ensure markdowns are completed within the agreed window, to protect sell-through and reduce waste

actions.ISSUE: Optimize shelf space layout in Food-to-Go
actions.EXPLANATION: Food-to-Go availability dropped to 88.2% vs 94% target. Top 5 lines by volume are frequently out of stock before noon. Planogram compliance in this section is currently at 71%.
actions.COST_IF_NOT_FIXED: Weekend demand spike expected - plan replenishment accordingly.
actions.RECOMMENDED_ACTION: Review and realign shelf space allocation in Food-to-Go to match current sales velocity. High-velocity lines should have additional facings; slow movers should be reduced.

actions.EXPLANATION: Bakery markdown compliance has fallen to 68% this week vs 92% target. 43% of waste in Bakery this week could have been avoided with timely markdowns. PM team needs additional coaching on scanning reduced-price labels.
actions.COST_IF_NOT_FIXED: Daily waste value in Bakery is trending up - immediate action needed.
actions.RECOMMENDED_ACTION: Increase markdown execution compliance during the 6pm window to minimize waste while maximizing sell-through on short-life items.
